stories.title: Imagens gigantes de Nossa Senhora Aparecida no interior de SP simbolizam proteção a motoristas e lembram origem da devoção

en.title: Giant images of Nossa Senhora Aparecida in interior of SP symbolize protection for drivers and recall origin of devotion
en.summary: A resident in São Paulo created a devotional site featuring giant religious sculptures, including two statues of Nossa Senhora Aparecida up to 10 meters tall, along a highway. The space called Caminho dos Devotos was established in 2020 and contains nearly 20 religious representations.

stories.title: Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida: Veja o que abre e o que fecha no feriado desta segunda (12) em Rio Branco

en.title: Day of Nossa Senhora Aparecida: See what opens and closes on the holiday this Monday (12) in Rio Branco
en.summary: Rio Branco observes a national holiday on Monday, October 12, honoring Nossa Senhora Aparecida, Brazil's patron saint. State and municipal public services are closed for the day, though essential services remain operational.

stories.title: Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida: acompanhe a Festa da Padroeira do Brasil no Santuário Nacional

en.title: Day of Nossa Senhora Aparecida: follow the celebration of Brazil's Patroness at the National Sanctuary
en.summary: The National Basilica in Aparecida held a series of religious activities on Monday, October 12, including masses, novenas, processions, and other tributes to Nossa Senhora Aparecida, Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida do Sul: relato de milagre concedido a tropeiro deu origem a santuário em Itapetininga

en.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida do Sul: report of miracle granted to muleteer gave origin to sanctuary in Itapetininga
en.summary: In 1911, a group of muleteers traveling from southern Brazil to Sorocaba left one member behind in Itapetininga after he became ill. Companions provided the sick man with shelter, medicine, food, and water before continuing their journey.

stories.title: Nobel de Economia 2026 vai para Robert E. Hall e Michael Woodford

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics goes to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
en.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for their work on the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization. The award was announced by Sweden's Royal Academy of Sciences.

stories.title: Robert E. Hall e Michael Woodford ganham Prêmio Nobel de Economia

en.title: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford were awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics.

stories.title: Como Daniel e Ana Castela, confira famosos devotos de Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Like Daniel and Ana Castela, check out famous devotees of Our Lady of Aparecida
en.summary: Various celebrities are devotees of Our Lady of Aparecida, seeking her protection and giving thanks for personal and professional achievements. The article profiles some of these famous followers on her feast day.

stories.title: Conheça as histórias e os mistérios da Sala dos Milagres de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em Uberlândia

en.title: Learn about the stories and mysteries of the Miracles Room of Our Lady of Aparecida in Uberlândia
en.summary: The Miracles Room in Uberlândia houses personal objects left by devotees as testimonies of answered prayers, healings, and gratitude. Each item represents a promise or hope from those who sought the saint's intercession.

stories.title: Irmãs realizam sonho da maternidade após trajetórias de superação médica e pedidos a Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Sisters fulfill motherhood dreams after medical challenges and prayers to Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: Two sisters in Brazil achieved motherhood after facing medical obstacles. Both credited their devotion to Nossa Senhora Aparecida, with one conceiving after praying at a church and the other becoming a mother following cancer treatment and miscarriages.

stories.title: Recorde de governadores eleitos no 1º turno amplia desafio de Lula e Flávio contra abstenção

en.title: Record number of governors elected in first round broadens Lula and Flávio's challenge against abstention
en.summary: Brazil experienced a record number of governors elected in the first round of elections, presenting challenges for Lula and Flávio regarding voter abstention in upcoming electoral contests.

stories.title: Devotas atribuem cura a Nossa Senhora Aparecida e retribuem com apoio a romeiros

en.title: Devotees attribute healing to Our Lady of Aparecida and reciprocate with support for pilgrims
en.summary: Two women dedicated Sunday to caring for pilgrims traveling along Presidente Dutra highway toward the sanctuary after attributing personal recoveries to Our Lady of Aparecida. One provides water after her daughter's cardiac issue, the other volunteered after her breast cancer diagnosis.

stories.title: Americanos Michael Woodford e Robert Hall ganham o Nobel de Economia

en.title: Americans Michael Woodford and Robert Hall win the Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: Robert Hall and Michael Woodford from the United States received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their research on how fiscal and monetary policies stabilize economic fluctuations.

stories.title: Em crise por gastos com aposentadorias e austeridade, escolas públicas da França perdem alunos ricos

en.title: In crisis over retirement spending and austerity, French public schools lose wealthy students
en.summary: French public schools are experiencing enrollment declines among affluent families due to recurring staff strikes and facility deterioration. The discontent has fueled significant protests across the country's education system.

stories.title: Robert Hall e Michael Woodford vencem Prêmio Nobel de Economia de 2026

en.title: Robert Hall and Michael Woodford win 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: Americans Robert Hall and Michael Woodford won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for their contributions to microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization. The prize is valued at 12 million Swedish crowns.

en.summary: A published author discusses her practice of listening to heavy metal music while writing to maintain concentration. The article examines workplace use of headphones.
